Predicates:
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
NameOfGame(x, y) ::: x is the name of game y.

Premises:
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (MadeBy(x, y) ∧ JapaneseCompany(y))) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
